result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B says plainly that the spec reads like a generic marketplace template rather than a seed library. It also hedges its domain assumptions ("probably free… confirm the actual model first") and points to more missing pieces, such as the gear icon and tab destinations. A gives better example replacement copy (the hall pickup notice and the borrowed-nothing empty state) but states some guesses as fact, such as "the cupboard may have no signal" and "most seed packets will be photographed by volunteers". | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B covers more of the generic content: the hero copy, 'Nothing to see here yet', the 'Item Title' placeholder and the email. It also asks for one action vocabulary (borrow, return, list, donate) across 'Explore', 'Get Started' and 'Discover', and gives example rewrites for both the hero and the empty state, using the community hall. A makes similar structural points with fewer rewrites, but it invents slightly less; B adds unsupported claims like 'the cupboard may have no signal' and 'most seed packets will be photographed by volunteers'.
